newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo to auction Sabesp shrs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo to auction Sabesp shrs Thursday.

text.p: Sao Paulo state government will sell a 4.28 percent voting stake in sewage company Sabesp at an auction on the local bolsa Thursday, a company official said.
A total of 1.187 billion voting shares will be auctioned at 1330 local/1630 GMT for a minimum price of 313 reais per lot of 1,000 stock.
Another four percent have already been offered to investors when Sabesp stock began trading on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) on June 4.
Sabesp voting shares have risen over 20 percent since the stock made its Bovespa debut.

Control of Sabesp is in the hands of the Sao Paulo state Finance secretariat Companhia Paulista de Ativos (CPA), a holding covering the assets the state plans to privatize and the state's water and energy department.
On Tuesday, Sabesp common stock jumped 4.55 percent to close at 345 reais.
